# Margin Genie (마진지니) — Full LLM Context

## What is Margin Genie?

Margin Genie is a free web application for Korean online sellers to calculate contribution profit, net margin rate, break-even price, ROAS, and channel-specific profitability before listing or running promotions.

The product philosophy: **the UI and AI layers never calculate numbers**. All monetary results come from a deterministic Margin Engine in `src/engine`. An optional Pro AI explanation layer only interprets engine output.

## Who is it for?

- Pre-launch sellers asking "what price avoids loss?"
- Multi-channel sellers comparing Smart Store vs Coupang vs own store
- Brand operators simulating discounts, coupons, ads, and free shipping

## Calculation model

- Metric: **contribution profit** (공헌이익), not statutory net income
- Inputs: list price, product cost, shipping, packaging, channel fees, ads, discounts, coupons, returns
- Outputs: contribution profit, margin rate, break-even price, target margin price, ROAS, monthly unit targets
- Fee policies: each channel has components with verification status (VERIFIED, ESTIMATED, USER_DEFINED)

## Channel fee notes

| Channel | Default fee handling |
|---------|---------------------|
| Naver Smart Store | VERIFIED sales fee + Npay by grade; marketing inflow 1% option |
| Coupang | ESTIMATED category presets + slider override |
| 11st, Gmarket, Auction, Kakao, Lotte ON | ESTIMATED with override |
| Own store | PG fee estimated ~3.3% VAT excluded |

## Free vs Pro

**Free**
- Full calculator, 8-channel compare, scenarios, CSV/PDF, share links, full JSON backup, sensitivity analysis

**Pro (trial)**
- Cloud upload/restore of input + scenarios + compare channels
- Team workspace import via account share code
- AI explanation layer: structured narrative from engine results (no recalculation)

## FAQ (canonical answers)

Q: Does AI calculate margins?
A: No. Margin Engine calculates; explanation reads results only.

Q: Are fees official?
A: Smart Store fees are VERIFIED from official FAQ. Others are ESTIMATED unless user overrides.

Q: What is VAT mode?
A: Users can enter list/cost as VAT-excluded supply price; fee VAT handling follows channel policy.

Q: How are coupons handled?
A: Seller-bearer coupons reduce net sales; platform-bearer do not; shared coupons use seller share ratio.

## Technical

- Stack: React + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind
- Tests: Vitest unit + Playwright E2E
- PWA: Workbox offline cache on production build
- Deploy: Vercel SPA

## Disclaimer

Not tax, investment, or legal advice. Final settlement must be verified in each seller center.
